citations.narrative:
Barn swallows have established nests and are actively residing in the barn that houses the horses and goats. While
inspecting the barn, fifteen swallows were observed flying above the stalls. Bird droppings were noted on the wooden stall
structures, concrete flooring, and various fixed items within the barn. Avian pests can carry/spread disease that could
negatively impact the animals housed in the barn. A safe and effective program for the control of pests including avian
pests shall be established and maintained. Correct by 10/9/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the attending veterinarian.
